summary: This 8-K reports entry into an underwriting agreement by Ford Credit Floorplan LLC and Ford Credit Floorplan Corp. (depositors) for an asset-backed securities issuance by Ford Credit Floorplan Master Owner Trust A. No special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, restructuring) is disclosed. The filing concerns a routine structured-finance offering under a pre-existing shelf registration, with standard terms described in the prospectus. There is no change of control, shareholder return, or corporate action that qualifies as a special situation. This is a routine capital-markets transaction, not a special situation.
